objects.taxonomy_description: Elongated bicycle with two seats and two sets of pedals arranged in tandem (one behind the other). The frame is significantly longer than a standard bicycle (approximately 2 meters), with an extended top tube connecting the front and rear triangles. Two handlebars are present: the front rider steers, the rear rider has fixed or adjustable handlebars. Both riders have individual saddles positioned at different heights along the frame. The wheels are standard bicycle size (26-28 inches). The overall silhouette is a stretched bicycle profile with two distinct rider positions.

objects.taxonomy_description: Stringed instrument with solid or semi-hollow body (no sound hole required). Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway, contoured edges), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body). Body is wood (alder, mahogany, maple) with glossy polyester or nitrocellulose finish in solid colors, sunburst, or natural wood grain. Neck is maple or mahogany with fretted fingerboard (rosewood or maple, 21-24 frets). Pickups (magnetic, 1-3) mounted on body. Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch. Bridge is fixed or tremolo. Headstock has 6 tuning pegs. Cable jack on body edge.

objects.taxonomy_description: Large penguin measuring 85-95 cm in height with distinctive black and white plumage. Head, back, and flippers are glossy black with vibrant orange-yellow auricular patches extending from ear region down neck sides. Breast and belly are white transitioning to pale yellow on upper breast. Bill is long, slender, and black with bright orange-pink lower mandible and base. Flippers are stiff and paddle-shaped, black on both surfaces. Feet are black and webbed. Body exhibits bilateral symmetry with upright torpedo-shaped profile adapted for swimming. Neck is elongated with orange coloration. Juveniles display brown-grey plumage lacking orange markings. Weight ranges 9-18 kg. Flightless; swims using flipper propulsion.
